grid.$description: Design tokens for the horizontal-flow data grid

font.$description: Font stack for the whole grid

headerFontSize.$description: Header font size, where it differs from cells

rowHeight.$description: Height of a data row, which also decides how many rows fit in an instance

instanceGap.$description: Gap between instances in the flow layout

radius.$description: Corner radius on instances and controls

treeIndent.$description: Indent applied per tree depth level

surface.$description: Behind the whole grid, including the gaps between instances

placeholderBackground.$description: Background of an offscreen instance placeholder

textMuted.$description: Secondary text, such as a sort order badge

border.$description: Instance outlines and the header's bottom rule

borderSubtle.$description: Lines between rows and columns, quieter than the border

selectionBackground.$description: Background of a selected row, tinted so the row beneath still reads

flashUp.$description: Flash colour when a value rises, following the trading convention of green for up

flashDown.$description: Flash colour when a value falls

flashNeutral.$description: Flash colour when the direction is unknown or disabled

flashDuration.$description: How long a cell flash lasts

instanceBorderWidth.$description: Border around an instance. Also read when sizing the slot, so the columns inside fit the content box rather than being clipped by it

disabledOpacity.$description: Opacity of a disabled control, such as a checkbox on a row that cannot be selected

treeExpanderSize.$description: Hit area of the tree expander

sortIndicatorFontSize.$description: Size of the sort direction arrow in a header

sortOrderFontSize.$description: Size of the sort position badge, shown when more than one column is sorted

filterInputWidth.$description: Width of a per-column filter input

filterFontSize.$description: Font size inside a filter input

numericVariant.$description: Figure settings for cells: tabular widths so a column of prices aligns, and a slashed zero so 0 and O are not confusable in an instrument code
